name: Bilaspur–Kharagpur Highway
aka: Formed from parts of the former NH 200 and NH 6
history: NH 49 links central India with the busy Kolkata–Chennai corridor. It starts at Bilaspur in Chhattisgarh, runs through the industrial towns of Raigarh and Jharsuguda, and crosses the hills and forests of northern Odisha past Keonjhar. It ends near Kharagpur in West Bengal, where it meets NH 16. The route was formed in the 2010 renumbering from the old NH 200 and part of the old NH 6.
facts: Joins NH 16, the Kolkata–Chennai highway, near Kharagpur.
Passes through Keonjhar, one of India's biggest iron-ore mining districts.
Jashipur on the route is a gateway to Simlipal National Park.
Crosses four states: Chhattisgarh, Odisha, Jharkhand and West Bengal.
